item.title: July jobs report reveals unexpected loss of 23,000 jobs
item.description: Friday's jobs report showed employers shed jobs last month, rather than adding 95,000 new hires that had been forecast by economists.

item.title: A quandary for the Fed: Dealing with hot inflation and cool job growth
item.description: A sudden slump in hiring has dramatically changed the outlook for the Federal Reserve's September interest rate decision.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's psychiatrists testify at her murder trial
item.description: Psychiatrists who treated Lindsay Clancy​ before she killed her children in Massachusetts testified at her trial Friday.

item.title: Idaho shooting video shows gunman start deadly rampage in In-N-Out drive-thru
item.description: Three people were killed in the shooting that started at an In-N-Out restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho.

item.title: Pentagon releases new batch of UFO files: "Did you see that?"
item.description: The Pentagon on Friday released a new batch of documents and images related to UFOs, the fifth disclosure in recent months about the strange encounters.

item.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Aug. 9, 2026
item.description: This week's guests include NIH Director Dr. Jay Bhattacharya, Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy and independent Sen. Bernie Sanders.

item.title: DOJ's top prosecutor in LA hires aide with pending battery charge, DUIs
item.description: First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli hired former top aide Shawn Lewis to be a federal law enforcement liaison, though Lewis has three prior convictions for driving under the influence and a pending battery charge.

item.title: Trump announces $180 million to boost mining education
item.description: President Trump announced over $180 million in grants to boost educational programs for the mining industry, part of a bid to increase critical mineral production.

item.title: Watch: Pentagon releases 16 new UFO videos
item.description: The Defense Department released a fifth batch of UFO files on Friday, nearly one month after its fourth drop. These are all of the videos in the latest tranche.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis escalate deadly attacks on Saudi-backed troops
item.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels launch fresh attacks on Saudi-backed government troops, says Yemeni state media, as Cruz says Trump must seek "regime collapse."

item.title: Inside Lindsay Clancy's Home | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
item.description: As the Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues, jurors hear testimony from the medical professionals who treated her before and after the deaths of her three children, and excerpts of her journal. They also visit key scenes from the night of the killings. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty speaks with WBZ-TV reporter and anchor Kristina Rex about emotional courtroom moments, graphic testimony, and the key question at the heart of this case: what was happening in Lindsay Clancy's mind on January 24, 2023?

item.title: Trump mounts new effort to fire Fed's Lisa Cook after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: The White House has informed Lisa Cook, a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, that President Trump is considering firing her.

item.title: Ted Cruz says U.S. should arm Iranian protesters for an uprising. Is that plan realistic?
item.description: Texas Republican Sen. Ted Cruz says the U.S. should consider arming Iranian protesters so they can rise up against the regime. Alex Vatanka, a senior fellow at the Middle East Institute, reacts to the remarks.

item.title: Tense exchange at Lindsey Clancy murder trial after lawyer makes explosive claim
item.description: More testimony transpired at Lindsey Clancy's murder trial in Massachusetts, and the judge presiding had a tense exchange with the defense. CBS News Boston's Kristina Rex reports.

item.title: These are the "pink flags" to look for in postpartum psychosis, according to a doctor
item.description: Perinatal psychiatrist Dr. Uruj Kamal Haider told Norah O'Donnell on "Healthful" that it's important to identify the early signs of postpartum psychosis, which she described as "pink flags."

item.title: More than 50 decomposing bodies found at Far South Side funeral home
item.description: An investigation was underway at a Far South Side funeral home after more than 50 decomposing bodies were found in the facility.

item.title: Energy company sues data center over who should pay for AI buildout
item.description: At issue is who pays to expand energy infrastructure when a data center​​ needs as much electricity​ as a midsize city.

item.title: Mom describes "perfect storm" that likely triggered her postpartum psychosis
item.description: Kriti Lodha opened up about her battle with postpartum psychosis back in 2020, describing "a perfect storm of sleep deprivation, being a new mom, a traumatic birth experience," which she believes may have triggered it. "I didn't know, frankly, if I would ever come out of it," Lodha told Norah O'Donnell on "Healthful."

item.title: Senate passes long-stalled Russia sanctions bill championed by Lindsey Graham
item.description: The Senate has tried for more than a year to get the legislation imposing sanctions on Russia across the finish line. It also includes sanctions on Iran.

item.title: How much interest can a 9-month CD earn savers who open an account this August?
item.description: Interest tied to a CD of this length could be substantial and accessible relatively quickly for savers who act now.

item.title: Cassidy backs Blanche for attorney general, clearing way for confirmation
item.description: Louisiana Sen. Bill Cassidy, a Republican, announced he will vote to confirm Todd Blanche for attorney general.

item.title: Senate passes bill championed by Lindsey Graham to impose huge sanctions on Russia
item.description: The Senate passed a bill championed by late South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham to impose new sanctions against Russia. CBS News' Nikole Killion reports.

item.title: Appeals court blocks Trump's White House ballroom, teeing up Supreme Court fight
item.description: A federal appeals court said the White House lacks the authority to unilaterally construct the 90,000-square-foot ballroom. President Trump said the administration will appeal to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Water rationing begins in Puerto Rico amid drought crisis: "It's brutal"
item.description: Puerto Rico's massive rationing measure comes amid a severe drought on top of shortages due to infrastructure issues.

item.title: These NYC centers allow hard drug use in-house. Nearly 5 years in, is it helping?
item.description: An addiction-services nonprofit approved by the city focuses on harm reduction for hard drug users — to the chagrin of some in the neighborhood.

item.title: Americans got their biggest raises in 40 years. Inflation took most of it.
item.description: The typical American's paycheck has grown faster since 2019 than in any stretch since the early 1980s. But prices climbed nearly as fast, swallowing about 80% of the wage increase.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign key defense agreement
item.description: The agreement says any armed attack against one of the three states will be regarded as an attack on them all, Pakistan and Turkey said in statement.

item.title: Flesh-eating bacteria has killed 5 in Louisiana this year, officials say
item.description: A flesh-eating bacteria found in warm coastal waters is responsible for at least five deaths so far this year in Louisiana, state health officials reported Thursday.

item.title: New details on Twin Falls In-N-Out shooting after 3 killed, 7 wounded
item.description: The suspect, identified as 24-year-old Chad Williams, died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said.

item.title: Idaho In-N-Out shooting victims remembered by loved ones: "She lit up a room"
item.description: Three people were killed and seven others were wounded in the Saturday attack in Twin Falls, Idaho. The gunman died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, officials said.
